verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs say the platform includes enterprise risk management: the getting-started guide covers "manage risks", and the SOC 2 Launchpad has users "action policies, risks, and evidence". The AI-system risk scoring and vendor risk assessment features cover different scopes and are not credited here. missing for 10: documented risk scoring for the general risk register, treatment plans, risk owners, recurring review cycles, risk-to-control mapping, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, a real risk register lives in the platform — scored risks, treatment plans, owners, and review cycles tied back to controls

citations.quote: configure governance, build a security programme, and manage risks for complete compliance readiness
generate your blueprint, and action policies, risks, and evidence
